ranking_rule:
Forensic-value ordering, declared rather than felt: an instrument that imports,
    has a named control, has a committed execution artefact and has callers outside its
    own package ranks above one missing any of those. Ties keep table order.
reading_rule: import=IMPORTS means the module imports in a fresh interpreter, nothing more; callers counts importers outside the instrument's own package and tests; control quotes a path or says NONE; artifacts are files matching the declared globs with git's last touch. None of these is a claim of scientific value.
